user_selection: All non-overlapping personal additions, regardless of service ownership

semantics.domain: All custom domains become domain_suffix. Existing suffix equality/ancestor is full coverage; adding an ancestor of an existing suffix/exact rule is partial overlap and is skipped. Exact-only matches do not provide full suffix coverage.
semantics.ip: Compare network ranges, not strings. Covered/partially intersecting CIDRs are skipped, including within the inputs. Discord network+port restrictions are preserved; scoped-only rules do not count as unrestricted coverage.
semantics.ownership: User-collected lists are personal routing requests, not verified Meta/Telegram endpoint registries. Shared CDN/hosting ranges can route unrelated traffic. No DNS-generated IPs.
semantics.snapshot: Overlap was checked against the selected sources in the successful baseline build, not every category in the upstream repositories.
